components.label: Observation / goal image
components.responsibility: Observed RGB frame or goal RGB image; future frames are targets during training only.

components.label: Unknown → NULL
components.responsibility: Start zeros and goal uniform incoming conditions use known=False and become the same learned NULL token.

components.label: Image tokens
components.responsibility: Patch projection, state readout token, NULL token, spatial positional embeddings; full spatial attention.

components.label: Shared Transformer Fθ
components.responsibility: Exactly one trainable Transformer trunk serves image reading and causal latent prediction in the shared model.

components.label: Shared readout Rθ
components.responsibility: Shared trainable MLP readout weights; image and prediction paths have separate affine-free BatchNorm running statistics.

components.label: Observed / target latents
components.responsibility: Canonical state vectors z_t and goal z_g are encoded identically; target latents retain gradients.

components.label: Candidate action sequences
components.responsibility: Sequences contain k physical actions; categorical distributions are sampled as complete trajectories, not averaged embeddings.

components.label: Latent–action tokens
components.responsibility: Interleaved history-state/action pairs plus query and temporal/type embeddings; causal mask.

components.label: Latent rollout
components.responsibility: Autoregressively feed predicted state back into bounded history; no imagined pixel frames or future observations.

components.label: Multi-step MSE + SIGReg
components.responsibility: MSE against encoded future states plus Gaussian characteristic-function regularization of encoded states.

components.label: Categorical CEM / MPC
components.responsibility: Minimize final predicted latent mean-square distance to encoded goal, iteratively update action probabilities, execute first physical action.

components.label: Observed-goal STOP
components.responsibility: Compare current observed latent and goal with calibrated threshold; emit protocol STOP one-hot if within threshold.

components.label: Environment
components.responsibility: Execute first selected action, observe a new frame, re-encode and update real history. Environment never supplies future observations to candidate rollouts.

authority_boundaries.description: Only the environment supplies real new observations; latent candidate rollout has no access to future images.
Goal enters planning cost and STOP check, not dynamics prediction.
Future observations supply training targets only. Both encoding and prediction receive gradients; no EMA/stop-gradient target network.
Trunk and all trainable readout weights shared; image/prediction BN buffers separate.

formulas.text: z_t = Eθ(o_t; NULL), z_g = Eθ(o_g; NULL)
Eθ and Pθ reuse Fθ and trainable Rθ; different tokenization and attention masks
L = mean_h MSE(hat z_(t+h), z_(t+h)) + λ SIGReg(encoded states)

forbidden_claims: No learned policy or BC loss in Uni-LeWM core. CEM produces action distributions; model goal STOP output is hard-coded metadata.
No Bayesian optimization, Gaussian-process surrogate, acquisition function, high/low fidelity evaluators, or dual-fidelity learning algorithm. Third requested style is visual grammar only.
No pixel decoder or future-image input during imagined rollout.
No independently parameterized target encoder, EMA, or stop-gradient targets.
No goal input directly into Pθ.
No physical STOP transition or guaranteed absorbing state.
Do not imply current encoder accepts known action conditions: encode(known=True) explicitly raises.
Do not average soft-action embeddings to represent uncertain futures: sample complete trajectories.
Do not claim the same BN running statistics are shared.
Do not hard-code d=192 or six layers in a general overview; toy benchmark uses d=48/two layers.
No paper-benchmark superiority or performance numbers should be introduced into method overview.
